desc: Parse N, M, and all constraints; build adjacency storing (neighbor, Z_i).
Traverse each component assigning p[v] = XOR along tree path; detect contradictions (incl. self-loop with Z != 0) and output -1.
Record component membership; count set bits of p[v] per component.
Choose offset bit = 1 iff count*2 > component_size, minimizing ones per component/bit.
Reconstruct A[v] = p[v] XOR offset; print space-separated.
